name: Priscilla
source:
Queen consort, fourth in rank.

Originally from a noble family, she was brought to the wrath of Celecia.

Priscilla was recognized for her skill in magic and became a warrior queen.

[From [url=http://www.terra.dti.ne.jp/~f-rui/works/myworks/mahara_simai/sisters_top.html]official site[/url]]
